title: Grace By The Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: The outdoor amenities are just as impressive, with a golf cart and four bikes included for exploring the scenic surroundings. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi, and enjoy the convenience of a full-size washer and dryer. Whether you’re lounging in the expansive living area or whipping up a meal in the spacious kitchen, every moment spent here promises comfort and relaxation. With its incredible location and thoughtfully designed features, this 30A beach house is the ultimate setting for creating unforgettable memories by the sea. Accommodating up to twelve guests, this spacious home features a large living area with a queen sleeper, a fully equipped kitchen, and even a second fridge in the garage to store all your vacation essentials. The master bedroom boasts a king bed, while the second master bedroom upstairs offers a queen bed and a bathroom with double vanity sinks. Additional sleeping arrangements include a third bedroom with a queen bed and a charming bunk room with built-in bunks for four.
